newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's February CPI +1.2 vs +0.4 in January.
newsitem.headline: Israel's February CPI +1.2 vs +0.4 in January.

text.p: The Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator on Friday:
ISRAEL CONSUMER PRICES Feb 97 Jan 97 Feb 96
Note: To compare previous indices based on 1987=100.0, multiply indices from January 1994 by 2.421.
The CPI for February marked a sharp acceleration from the previous seven months.
The bureau attributed the rise to higher fruit and vegetable prices due to climatic reasons as well as higher housing costs. The housing index rose 1.4 percent.
The strengthening of the dollar against the Israeli shekel this year fed into higher prices for homes.
Housing prices are customarily set in dollars in Israel, which is why the U.S. currency influences their price.
